title: GitHub - Team Synchronization for GitHub is Paused
text:
Service: GitHub
Maintenance: Team Synchronization for GitHub is Paused
Status: completed
Impact: maintenance
Scheduled for: 2022-03-28T12:00:00.000Z
Scheduled until: 2022-03-28T16:30:00.000Z
Updates:
- 2022-03-28T15:02:24.112Z: completed - The scheduled maintenance has been completed.
- 2022-03-28T12:01:33.296Z: in_progress - Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.
- 2022-03-25T17:35:10.285Z: scheduled - Team synchronization for GHEC organizations will proactively be paused on Monday, March 28th from 12:00 to 16:30 UTC to reduce mySQL1 load. Some teams may see delayed synchronization of teams linked to security group memberships on GitHub Enterprise Cloud and invited users may see delays in access to organizational resources. There will be no impact to enterprise managed users and groups.

incident.name: Team Synchronization for GitHub is Paused

incident_updates.body: The scheduled maintenance has been completed.
Scheduled maintenance is currently in progress. We will provide updates as necessary.

Team synchronization for GHEC organizations will proactively be paused on Monday, March 28th from 12:00 to 16:30 UTC to reduce mySQL1 load. Some teams may see delayed synchronization of teams linked to security group memberships on GitHub Enterprise Cloud and invited users may see delays in access to organizational resources. There will be no impact to enterprise managed users and groups.
